adjudication.reason: Direct MagicStack.addAndUnfreeze materialization proves native stack presence and target legality but does not prove that casting completed or costs were paid. Request-bound booleans cannot receive rules-state credit.
adjudication.minimum_allowed_remediation: Forge-native stack-state restoration API whose successful operation owns and exposes restored completed-cast/payment history, validates requested target state through Forge Core, and lets Commander-Lab normalize only native observations. Requested cast_complete/costs_paid booleans must not be inputs to the native observation result.
forbidden: copy requested cast_complete/costs_paid into normalized state
hide target additions from normalized state

next_action: Implement the minimal Forge-native stack-state restoration/history API on the GPL Forge branch, add native observation of targets and restored cast/payment history, rerun affected Forge engine gates, then retarget WS40 construction to immutable v1.0.3 and execute from record 1.
